name: Suzumiya Haruka
source:
A member of squad A-01 and sister of Akane. She is always together with Mitsuki, her best friend and former romantic rival.

Her legs got crushed during a training exercise and got replaced with artificial ones. While her new legs perform quite well in normal situations, they aren't as good enough to let her pilot mecha and fight on the front lines, so she takes support roles instead.
